data.rationale: This commit changes foreign key (RI) checking in ri_triggers.c so that FK values requiring an implicit cast function to reach the equality operator's type are routed through SPI rather than the fast path. Function ri_check_fastpath_index now checks pg_cast to determine if a cast function is required and caches this eligibility state. Cross-type operators, binary-compatible types, and domains remain on the fast path. SQL statements reaching these paths involve creating foreign keys between cross-type columns (such as int referencing bigint) or types with implicit cast functions, followed by INSERT or UPDATE operations.
data.grammar_fragment:
alter_table @scope
  : <1.5> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(bigint) ")" REFERENCES "t1" "(" "c0" ")" NOT VALID
  | <1.5> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(int) ")" REFERENCES "t2" "(" "c0" ")" NOT VALID
  | <1> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(numeric) ")" REFERENCES "t2" "(" "c0" ")" NOT VALID
  ;
